hypothesis: In the prospectively selected Danish panel, later minus earlier genotype affinity to Sidelkino relative to Bar8, and to KK1 relative to Bar8, is positive separately on each of the three fixed autosomal windows.
method: Genotype-only f4(later,earlier;Sidelkino,Bar8) and f4(later,earlier;KK1,Bar8) on GRCh37 chr20,chr21,chr22 [20,30)Mb. Preserve the existing five earlier/five later queries and eight named proxy subjects. Freeze exact genotype-dosage/call/support rules from source/header metadata before any genotype row is read. Retain per-variant support and fixed1Mb block sums. No phasing, tree inference, neural model or ancestry truth.
repeat_policy: First prospective genotype-only corroboration for the separately frozen Danish cohort. It is not an accuracy benchmark or an unchanged model rerun. No window, proxy, cohort or dosage-rule substitution after observing outcomes. This tests a known historical pattern, not biological discovery or independent ancestry truth.
